name: GooeyNav-TS-TW
title: GooeyNav
blurb: Navigation with gooey background fill and particle burst effect on click.
description: A creative navigation menu where clicking an item triggers a particle burst animation using mathematical positioning and noise. Active item gets a smooth gooey background pill with custom easing. Text color inverts on active state.
use_when: You want an eye-catching, premium navigation that delights users with playful micro-interactions.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical contexts — custom keyboard support is basic; particle effects may distract.
a11y: Keyboard support: Enter/Space to activate items. Custom focus handling. ResizeObserver watches for layout changes. Particles are pointer-events-none.
